en.quote: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for His camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
en.riddle: for His camp is very great
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וַֽיהוָה נָתַן קוֹלוֹ לִפְנֵי חֵילוֹ כִּי רַב מְאֹד מַחֲנֵהוּ כִּי עָצוּם עֹשֵׂה דְבָרוֹ כִּֽי-גָדוֹל יוֹם-יְהוָה וְנוֹרָא מְאֹד וּמִי יְכִילֶֽנּוּ
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
